about: Divergence of ah2 from the recorded Node traces where a repository has no committed ah2 conventions file: ah2 then reads ah v1's .claude/ah-conventions.json, read-only, from the same ref, so a repository that opted in under v1 keeps its push rules. The recorded git log has one `cat-file -e <ref>:<conventions path>` probe; the native one has that probe of the ah2 path followed by a probe of v1's path.
ruling: 0118 R5 (Orchestrator, 2026-10-12): keep the fallback; the extra probe is a named divergence, not a failure

divergences.about: git.log trace: an absent ah2 conventions blob is followed by a `cat-file -e <ref>:.claude/ah-conventions.json` probe. A recorded trace whose probe found nothing and which has no blob read after it gains that line when the case is loaded (tests/contract-tools/lib-case.mjs withV1ConventionsFallback); a recorded trace that read the blob is unchanged, because the fallback is not consulted when the ah2 file exists.
